name: loom-agent
description: AI-powered project memory engine. Uses Anna LLM to analyze VS Code workspaces and power context-aware coding conversations.

credentials.name: FlowDev Token
credentials.description: Your FlowDev VS Code extension token from flowdev.onrender.com/request

tools.name: check_connection
tools.description: Check if the FlowDev VS Code extension is connected and the token is valid

tools.name: get_memory
tools.description: Get the stored project memory for the current workspace

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Start a Loom session — scans the workspace and loads project memory using Anna AI analysis

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Send a message to Loom. Uses Anna LLM with full project context to give intelligent, project-aware responses

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The message to send to Loom

parameters.name: conversationHistory
parameters.description: Previous messages in this conversation for context

tools.name: update_memory
tools.description: Manually update fields in project memory

parameters.name: updates
parameters.description: Key-value pairs to update in the project memory

tools.name: end_session
tools.description: End the current session and save a note about where you left off

parameters.name: sessionNote
parameters.description: A note about what was done this session and where you left off
